comment: M10: the part editor's output seen in the client. The world is pinned with editMode (test-hook override); the commands.editor scenario edits and exports a generated building's part, places that part with createpart at Y 120 in its arena chunk, and builds building1 (2 floors, 1 cellar) from Y 90 in the chunk east of it. The find takes the createbuilding position from the scenario's [LCNH-COMMANDS] line.
